subject: dispatch_main

observation.summary: _dispatch_main is defined in __TEXT,__text at arm64e offset 0x000120D0; the related anchor __dispatch_main_q (Apple-private double-underscore renaming) is defined at arm64e offset 0x0006FE40 and is referenced from __dispatch_main_queue_callback_4CF. There is no exported single-underscore _dispatch_main_q in the shipped arm64e binary; OSS defines it as _dispatch_main_q in src/init.c:259.

claim: dispatch_main is exported by libdispatch (macOS 27 / arm64e) as _dispatch_main at offset 0x120D0. The application's main queue is the static struct __dispatch_main_q (Apple-private double-underscore naming, arm64e offset 0x6FE40 in __DATA), which is the renamed form of the OSS-public symbol _dispatch_main_q (OSS src/init.c L259). The single-underscore _dispatch_main_q form is therefore APPLE-PRIVATE in the shipped binary -- a delta vs OSS that any external linkage to the main queue struct must route through the public dispatch_main() entry instead of relying on the OSS symbol spelling.
reproducer:
nm -arch arm64e -gU /usr/lib/system/introspection/libdispatch.dylib | grep -E '_dispatch_main$|dispatch_main$|__?_dispatch_main_q$'
# expect _dispatch_main present, __dispatch_main_q present (Apple-private), no bare _dispatch_main_q
